scenario: [LSTR.9.6]: DS has no locale-aware operations and no case mapping. `lower(m.text)` names no builtin, so the compiler refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION. Case-insensitive matching is computed adapter-side.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where lower(m.text) == "hello"
->
    log info "lowercased match"
